about: A webmail app that runs in the browser.

prs.title: Google Contacts exports import with emails and phone numbers
prs.broken: Importing a contacts file exported from Google today brought in only names and birthdays. Emails, phones, addresses, company and labels were silently dropped.
prs.changed: I taught the importer the column names Google uses now, and the company and label columns.
prs.matters: People moving their contacts from Google get the whole address book, not just names.
